text:
maria: Heads up — found a cleartext service credential in a partner helm values file that got uploaded to the staging charts bucket. Looks like a wrapped blob but the log shows an unwrapped conn string.

samir: Ugh. Which chart + path? can you paste the file path?

maria: gs://redwood-staging-charts/partner-x/1.4.2/values.yaml — inside `extra.env` there was `DATABASE_URL: postgresql://redwood_user:pwd123@staging-db:5432/redwood` (yes raw). 

luca: Yikes. Did the helm pipeline redact things? CI should have detected secrets.

maria: CI had a lint step but it only looked for direct base64 secrets. This file came from partner upload, bypassed our normal scan.

oncall: Incident severity? probable blast radius: staging-only, partner workload. No known prod leak yet.

security-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-145. Triage owner assigned: @samir. Please follow rotation runbook and post updates in this thread.

samir: Ok will take. First steps: (1) freeze partner chart bucket read access (2) rotate the DB user creds (3) search logs for any use of that DB user.

luca: I can do 1 and help with logs. samir do you want the DB rotate schedule?

samir: Yes. Plan: immediate credential rotation with ephemeral user, followed by rekeying of Vault transit wrap keys for any wrapped artifacts we find. Canary rollout for apps to verify. Proposed timeline: rotate creds within 30m, revoke old creds after verification within 2h.

maria: I've copied the values.yaml to a forensics bucket: gs://sec-evidence/SEC-2026-145/values.yaml and removed public ACL.

luca: Running a quick grep across logs for the username now: `gcloud logging read 'textPayload: "redwood_user"' --limit 200`

samir: Good. If we find connections from unknown IPs, escalate. Also need RBAC change: partner CI service account should lose bucket write until we confirm secure upload flow. @oncall can you patch the IAM binding?

oncall: On it — removing `roles/storage.objectCreator` for partner-ci@partner.iam.chrono in 2 mins and adding a grant to a quarantine bucket. I'll update ACLs.

devops-bot: IAM change applied by oncall at 3245678942 — removed objectCreator from partner-ci@partner.iam.chrono for gs://redwood-staging-charts/*

samir: Next: DB rotate. DB owner? @luca do you have rotation playbook creds for staging Postgres?

luca: I have a script in infra repo: `scripts/pg-rotate-user.sh`. Running now against staging. Command: 
```
./scripts/pg-rotate-user.sh --db staging-db --user redwood_user --rotate-to=redwood_user_rot1
```

maria: When you rotate, please create a Vault kv entry for the new creds and mark the old secret as `deprecated` (don't delete immediately). We need traces for rollback.

samir: Agree. Also need to check whether any wrapped secrets in Vault transit were created with the old wrapping key. If so we rewrap them with new wrapping key. We should create a transient rewrap key in KMS and then roll it to primary after validation.

luca: I found a few wrapped artifacts referencing `transit-key-2023` in Vault: `vault kv get -format=json secret/partner-x/app | jq '.data.data'` shows `wrapped_blob: ci-wrapped-blob`

samir: Rewrap steps (high level):
- provision a new KMS key version (or new key alias) `projects/.../locations/global/keyRings/rekey/cryptoKeys/rewrap-v1`
- use `gcloud kms keys versions create` or create new key and grant Vault transient decrypt/grant
- run `vault write sys/wrapping/rewrap` (pseudo) — actually we will use our rewrap utility `tools/rewrap` to decrypt-and-reencrypt with the new key in a controlled window

maria: We should also snapshot audit logs before any rewrap.

luca: Audit logs snapshot command: `gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access"' --start-time="2026-03-22T00:00:00Z" --format=json > /tmp/audit-snapshot.json`

samir: Good. Who will run rewrap? I can run the orchestrator but need someone to watch for failed decrypts in app telemetry.

maria: I will watch telemetry and add alert: `error: decrypt failed` on staging.

oncall: After IAM change, partner CI uploaded a new chart to quarantine bucket. No further plaintext found in the new upload.

samir: Ok proceed with rotate. Luca - run rotate script, create Vault entry, produce new creds to apps via our ConfigSync canary (1 pod in each k8s cluster). Rollback plan: if app reports DB auth errors beyond 5% in 10m, revert and re-evaluate.

luca: Rotate started at 3245678975. Script output: `created user redwood_user_rot1, updated grants`. Writing new creds to Vault at `secret/data/staging/db/redwood_user_rot1`

devops-bot: ConfigSync canary deployment triggered by pipeline at 3245678988 — targets: staging cluster (1 pod).

maria: Canary pod accepted new creds and connected successfully. Monitoring for 15m.

samir: Meanwhile I filed a short-term RBAC tweak: restrict Vault transit key access to `vault-service` only, and add an audit-only role for ops-readers. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-738 (do a quick review @luca)

luca: Reviewing PR now. Small nit on policy doc.

maria: Telemetry scan shows no external IPs using the old DB user. Looks internal and partner CI. Blast radius seems limited.

samir: After canary validation we will (A) revoke old DB creds, (B) rewrap any discovered transit artifacts, (C) run a full scan for similar values in other partner chart buckets, (D) follow up with partner on secure upload flow and add server-side secret scanning in ingest pipeline.

oncall: Revoke scheduled at 3245679120 if canary OK.

security-bot: Update: SEC-2026-145 — rotation complete, canary OK, old DB user revoked, partner CI IAM restricted. Follow-up owners: partner-security (engagement), infra (scanning).

maria: Filing a retro doc with steps and detection gap. I'll create a short-runbook snippet for partner uploads.

samir: Thanks everyone. Quick todo list:
- maria: retro + runbook (owner)
- luca: PR merge for RBAC change + run full chart scan (owner)
- oncall: confirm IAM quarantine policy enforcement (owner)
- samir: coordinate partner call and verify KMS rewrap completion (owner)

luca: :thumbsup: good job.

maria: closing this thread with final notes once retro is published.

security-bot: SEC-2026-145 closed at 3245679024 — closure note: staging-only leak, creds rotated, RBAC and pipeline mitigations in progress."
